title: Sign in
submitDisabledReason: Enter your e-mail address and password first.

serverDown.title: The server is not answering right now.
serverDown.detail: You can try to sign in anyway, or reload this page in a moment.

invalid_credentials.title: Sign-in failed
invalid_credentials.detail: E-mail address or password is incorrect.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.detail: Sign-in is paused after several failed attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

server_not_configured.title: Server configuration incomplete
server_not_configured.detail: Sign-in is unavailable until the server's keys are set. Check the server log.

database_unavailable.title: Database not available
database_unavailable.detail: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, check the server log.

server_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
server_unreachable.detail: Make sure the Hexmark server is running, then try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong on the server
unexpected.detail: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.

signInBlocked.title: Remove the setup token
signInBlocked.lead: Setup is complete, but SETUP_TOKEN is still set on the server. Sign-in stays blocked until it is removed.

steps.removeToken: Delete the SETUP_TOKEN line from the .env file, or leave it empty (SETUP_TOKEN=).
steps.restart: Restart the server so it reads the change. With Docker Compose, run docker compose up -d; a plain docker compose restart keeps the old value.
steps.reload: Reload this page. Once the token is gone, it takes you to sign-in.
